name: atlas-browser
description: A project-centered desktop browser for agentic research, durable context, and focused execution.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check electron-main.mjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check codex-agent.mjs && node --check agent-providers.mjs && node --check browser-control.mjs && node --check download-manager.mjs && node --check privacy-shield.mjs && node --check profile-website-sessions.mjs && node --check project-browser-isolation.mjs && node --check website-media-permissions.mjs && node --check website-window-routing.mjs && node --check public/app.js
scripts.test: node --test codex-agent-tools.test.mjs download-manager.test.mjs privacy-shield.test.mjs profile-website-sessions.test.mjs project-browser-isolation.test.mjs website-media-permissions.test.mjs website-window-routing.test.mjs public/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.release:check: pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm run audit:release
